role: Committed CI threshold file (ceiling) read by scripts/enforce_swiftlint_budget.sh (CI + make lint-budget); .githooks/pre-commit prints it advisory only.
toplevel: Single line `81`. Read by scripts/enforce_swiftlint_budget.sh (CI + make lint-budget); .githooks/pre-commit prints it advisory only. Every .ci/*.txt with an integer value is also compared against a baseline commit by scripts/check_budget_monotonicity.sh (ceilings may only fall, min_* floors may only rise, unless a `budget-raise-ok: .ci/swiftlint_warning_budget.txt` commit trailer is present in the compared range). Changes are owned by @chrissharp80 per CODEOWNERS.

flags.text: The budget is an exact count of SwiftLint warnings, but CI installs SwiftLint with an unpinned `brew install swiftlint`, so a new SwiftLint release that adds or changes rules moves the count independently of any code change and fails (or loosens) the gate.
